# Travel Cancellation Policy
        
        > Reference copy saved on 2026-06-15. Source: internal travel-service policy database.
        
        ---
        
        ## Free Cancellation Window
        
        | Route Type      | Window                        |
        |-----------------|-------------------------------|
        | Domestic        | Full refund within **24 hours** of booking |
        | International   | Full refund within **48 hours** of booking |
        
        ---
        
        ## Cancellation Fees by Cabin Class & Route Type
        
        | Cabin Class              | Route Type      | Cancellation Fee                          |
        |--------------------------|-----------------|-------------------------------------------|
        | **Basic Economy**        | Any             | Not cancellable after free window (unless insured) |
        | **Economy**              | Domestic        | max($50, 15% of ticket price)             |
        | **Economy**              | International   | max($75, 20% of ticket price)             |
        | **Business**             | Domestic        | 5% of ticket price                        |
        | **Business**             | International   | 8% of ticket price                        |
        | **First Class**          | Any             | Free cancellation (no fee)                |
        
        ---
        
        ## Travel Insurance
        
        - Travel insurance covers cancellation **regardless of cabin class**.
        - If the booking includes travel insurance, the cancellation fee is waived.
        
        ---
        
        ## Important Notes
        
        - **Route type matters:** Fees differ by route type (domestic vs. international). Always check the flight's `route_type` to determine the applicable fee.
        - **Basic Economy** tickets cannot be cancelled after the free cancellation window unless the booking includes travel insurance.
        - **First Class** tickets can be cancelled at any time with no fee.
        
        ---
        
        *End of cancellation policy.*
